name: PackageFlow
headline: PackageFlow - Visual DevOps Hub for npm, Git, and
short_description: PackageFlow is a visual DevOps hub for npm scripts, Git, workflows, and deployments. It allows developers to control these processes via AI using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The tool connects to npm, Git, and deployment pipelines, reducing the need for terminal commands and improving workflow efficiency.
author: runkids

sections.overview:
Skillshare App is a desktop application for the skillshare CLI, available on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It provides a visual interface for managing development workflows and processes. The app is actively under development and requires the skillshare CLI to be installed first. Installation options include Homebrew on macOS or direct downloads for all platforms.
Managing npm scripts and Git operations through a desktop interface
Controlling deployment pipelines and DevOps workflows visually
Automating development tasks across macOS, Windows, and Linux
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/runkids/PackageFlow`
sections.usage:
```
I'm using PackageFlow to automate my DevOps workflow for [PROJECT_NAME] in [COMPANY]. I need to set up a new npm script to run tests, commit changes to Git, and deploy to [DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT]. Can you generate the PackageFlow configuration for this workflow?
```
Copy

```
# PackageFlow Configuration for [PROJECT_NAME] Deployment Workflow
```

headline_vi: PackageFlow - Trung tâm DevOps trực quan cho npm, Git và
short_description_vi: PackageFlow là một trung tâm DevOps trực quan dành cho các npm script, Git, workflow và deployment. Công cụ này cho phép lập trình viên kiểm soát các quy trình này thông qua AI bằng cách sử dụng Model Context Protocol (MCP). Nhờ kết nối trực tiếp với npm, Git và các pipeline triển khai, PackageFlow giúp giảm thiểu việc sử dụng các câu lệnh terminal và tối ưu hóa hiệu suất quy trình làm việc.
